evals.name: oas32-stage0-plan
evals.prompt: I want to add OpenAPI 3.2.0 support to ApiDOM (parent version 3.1). Do only the research and planning step: produce the tracking document with the field map (new vs inherited fields per object), the external URLs we'll need, and every integration point across packages. Don't write code yet.
evals.expected_output: Tracking doc with accurate field map, verified URLs and complete cross-package integration list.
assertions: Field map names at least 15 of the 18 distinctive OAS 3.2 new fields
Components.pathItems, License.identifier and Info.summary are treated as inherited, not new
Does not list a webhooks field on Components
Lists apidom-reference parsers, resolve/dereference/bundle strategies and saturated.ts
Lists apidom-ls parser-factory.ts and content detection in utils
Lists the root package.json unlink script
Mentions propagating new fields to the replace-empty-element refractor plugin
Addresses detection exclusivity between the 3.1 and 3.2 adapters
